preconditions: this points to a live per-run object; callers are the frame/main-loop paths 0x0042D8A0 and 0x004B8AE0 (graph_context callers).
this+0x130 holds a wheel count used to bound each batch (DERIVED from the min() bound against it).
this+0x174 == -1 is the idle sentinel; a non-idle value is a partial-batch resume index carried across calls.
this+0x134 holds the base pointer of a per-wheel element array with stride 316 (DERIVED from base + 316 * index).
postconditions: Each call advances the index this+0x174 by at most 20 (batch end v3 = min(index + 20, count this+0x130)).
A phase transition (this+0x16C) occurs only when a batch end equals the count at this+0x130: phase 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 0.
On phase 2 completion the machine returns to idle: this+0x16C = 0 and this+0x174 = -1.

Phase 1 (this+0x16C == 1): calls sub_4FAF60(*(this+0x134) + 316 * index) once per wheel index (suspension callback, DERIVED name).
Phase 2 (this+0x16C == 2): calls VehicleProximity at 0x004FB2E0 with the same 316-stride wheel address (proximity callback, DERIVED name).
Writes state fields this+0x16C (phase selector), this+0x170 (target float), this+0x174 (index).
Uses CRT math fabs() in the idle-detection guard.

tests_required: Time-slicing: with count N > 20, repeated calls process every wheel exactly once across batches and no single call exceeds 20 iterations.
Phase sequencing: phase transitions at this+0x16C (0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 0) occur only when a batch end reaches the count at this+0x130.
Idle behavior: with this+0x174 == -1 and |float(this+0x170) - v9| <= 0.05, the call performs no per-wheel work and leaves state unchanged.
Init-on-idle: an idle call that differs beyond tolerance re-initializes to phase 0, index 0, target v9.
Per-wheel dispatch: each phase invokes its callback exactly once per index in order, with the 316-stride wheel address for phases 1 and 2.
